status: ignore arm complete; no_graph training still running; not adopted

prototype_audit.interpretation: Direction changes plus active loss/source checks support actual prototype optimization; this is not evidence of segmentation benefit by itself.

1.interpretation: Actual ignore action removes selected old labels without assigning novel labels; proposal precision describes the proposed class, not labels assigned during training.

prototype_audit.interpretation: Direction changes plus active loss/source checks support actual prototype optimization; this is not evidence of segmentation benefit by itself.

2.interpretation: Actual ignore action removes selected old labels without assigning novel labels; proposal precision describes the proposed class, not labels assigned during training.

graph.interpretation: Row new class from reliable CAM/PAR seed; column frozen teacher prediction; background retained in denominator but never correction target

teacher_graph_snapshot.interpretation: Seed-estimated teacher absorption, not GT confusion. Snapshot iteration comes from graph updates; it is not the 2000-step diagnostic graph.

gate_semantics.actual_gate: boolean top-2 supported old foreground columns per novel row, with >=3 distinct supporting images and strictly positive EMA count
gate_semantics.background_normalization_effect: A shared positive row denominator does not change within-row ranking or positivity. Since graph() returns a Boolean top-2 gate, retaining background in the denominator records interpretable rates but does not itself suppress weak foreground edges.
gate_semantics.limitation: Rare supported old predictions can still qualify for rows dominated by background; downstream feature/CAM/spatial/anchor filters remain required. This observation alone does not prove it caused the accuracy change.
gate_semantics.experiment_policy: Document limitation; do not change source or thresholds in the running fixed-protocol experiment.

limitations: Single training seed, adaptively inspected validation. Paired image bootstrap does not estimate training seed variance. Fixed alpha0.5. No GT image tags during segmentation inference. Confusion gate is Boolean top2, not absolute-rate weighted. no_graph only isolates the gate under hard correction, not under ignore.
